3162.title: Concurrent workflow surfaces duplicate the active run
3162.rootCauseOneLine: The workflows plugin independently and unconditionally renders the same running run in its message directive and active-run composer banner without distinct composer identity.
3162.proposedFix: Give the composer-only card a persistent visible Active prefix and an Active workflow accessible label while retaining the historical message preview.
3162.caveats: The rule prohibited starting a workflow, so the visual check rendered the unmodified production registrations with typed active-run fixture state instead of invoking a provider. The exact duplicate result was repeated in two clean checkouts.
